rulings.summary: Recurring credits are placed when the card becomes active and refilled to N before turn-begin trigger conditions are met; they may be spent only as the card allows.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet refills recurring credits at turn start before start-of-turn prompts and spends them only through restricted payment prompts.

rulings.summary: The threat level is the greatest score of any player; a Threat N ability is active only while the threat level is N or greater.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet compares threat N against the higher of both scores whenever the ability would apply.

rulings.summary: Dividends N places N agenda counters per advancement counter past the requirement, judged as the agenda began to be scored.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet counts excess advancements from the scored agenda before it leaves the server.

rulings.summary: Forfeiting moves an agenda from a score area to the removed-from-game zone; its points stop counting and it is gone for good.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet forfeits as a cost prompt and the agenda leaves the score area permanently.

rulings.summary: Regions are upgrades limited to one per server root; installing a second trashes the first, and the limit ignores central servers' ice.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet trashes the older region when a second is installed in the same root.

rulings.summary: A persistent ability on a rezzed Corp card the Runner trashes while accessing it keeps applying through a lingering effect for the rest of the run.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet keeps the persistent effect active until the run ends after an access trash.

rulings.summary: Limit 1 console per player: a second installed console trashes all but the most recent.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet trashes the previous console when another is installed.

rulings.summary: Sabotage N: the Corp chooses cards from HQ to trash and trashes the rest from the top of R&D, as one simultaneous trash; a short zone forces the other.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet asks the Corp to choose HQ cards then trashes the remainder from R&D.

rulings.summary: Bypassing ice aborts the encounter; the Runner passes the ice with no subroutines broken or resolved and no further encounter abilities.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet bypass moves straight to passing the ice.

rulings.summary: To derez a rezzed card is to turn it facedown; it stays installed and becomes inactive.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet derez flips the card facedown in place; hosted counters stay.

rulings.summary: Removed-from-game cards are inactive, open information and never return.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet shows a removed-from-game pile per player.

rulings.summary: Looking shows a card only to the looking player; revealing shows it to all and returns it to its state; visibility lasts until the ability finishes resolving.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet shows a private prompt for looks and a public log line for reveals.

rulings.summary: The action phase ends when the player has no clicks left or an ability ends it; 'when your action phase ends' triggers then, before the discard phase.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet fires action-phase-end triggers after the last click and before discards.

rulings.summary: In the discard step the active player discards down to maximum hand size; the discarded cards are known to the discard step.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet records the discarded cards and offers discard-triggered abilities after the step.

rulings.summary: Agendas are inactive while installed and in the Runner's score area unless their text says otherwise; they are active in the Corp's score area.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet lets the Corp use an agenda ability from the Runner's score area only where printed.

rulings.summary: Some operations have trash costs; the Runner may pay them to trash such an operation while accessing it in HQ or R&D.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet offers the basic trash ability on accessed operations with a trash cost.

rulings.summary: Each server has a sequence of ice positions; abilities can move the Runner directly to a position during a run.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet moves the Runner to the outermost position of the named server and continues by approaching that ice.

rulings.summary: The approach ice phase lets the Corp rez the approached ice; changes to the ice in the Runner's position change what is encountered.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet's approach triggers fire before the rez window.

rulings.summary: After passing all ice the Runner approaches the server; this is when 'when you would approach' replacements apply.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet changes the attacked server before the approach-server triggers.

rulings.summary: The attacked server is the server the Runner is attempting to reach; abilities may change it during the run.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet updates the attacked server for every later check in the run.

rulings.summary: Each player has one identity active in the play area; a double-sided identity's abilities are those of its current face.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet flips identities in place and shows the active face.

rulings.summary: Paid abilities are optional, used by their controller in priority windows; a card may let any player use an ability.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet offers 'any player' abilities to both players.

rulings.summary: Installing follows the installation steps one card at a time; abilities may install from zones other than hand and may ignore costs.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet installs from Archives, heap or score area through the same install prompt.

rulings.summary: Playing an event or operation pays its costs and resolves it; abilities may play a card from another zone and say where it goes after.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet plays from Archives and then removes the card from the game when printed.

rulings.summary: Searching looks through a zone for a card meeting the criteria; a searched deck is shuffled.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet shows the searchable cards privately and shuffles after.

rulings.summary: Swapping exchanges two cards' positions simultaneously.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet swaps ice positions without passing through Archives or HQ.

rulings.summary: Tags are counters on the Runner; removing tags is an effect or the basic action; abilities may count tags.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet counts the Runner's tags for conditions and removal triggers.

rulings.summary: Damage trashes cards from the grip at random; meat and net damage are prevented separately.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet resolves damage as a single random trash.

rulings.summary: Conditional abilities trigger on their condition and resolve when their controller has priority; 'first time each turn' limits a trigger to one occurrence.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet prompts optional conditional abilities and tracks first-time-each-turn facts.

rulings.summary: Subroutines resolve in order; an ability may resolve a subroutine of another card.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet resolves another ice's subroutine as if printed on the resolving ice.

rulings.summary: Ice has subtypes, strength and subroutines; abilities may give ice subtypes or change strength.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet applies granted subtypes to interface checks.

rulings.summary: Icebreakers interface with ice of matching subtype and sufficient strength; an ability may restrict which breakers can break a subroutine.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet hides break options a restriction forbids.

rulings.summary: Hosting places objects on a card; hosted cards may be faceup without being installed; a host changing zones trashes its hosted cards.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet shows faceup hosted cards beside their host.

rulings.summary: Costs are paid in full before effects; additional costs are part of the cost and may forfeit agendas or reveal and trash cards.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet pays additional costs in the cost prompt.

rulings.summary: Accessing a card shows it to the Runner; access abilities and the basic trash ability are available during access; some cards must be revealed while accessed.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet reveals cards that must be revealed while accessed in R&D.

rulings.summary: Static abilities apply continuously while active, including cost and strength modifiers.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet recalculates rez costs and strengths when a static source enters or leaves play.

rulings.summary: Advancing places advancement counters; abilities may place counters on cards that can be advanced, and such a card cannot be scored that turn where printed.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet blocks scoring of a card advanced by such an effect this turn.

rulings.summary: Counters are placed and removed as effects or costs; agenda and power counters are hosted counters.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet treats hosted counter removal as a cost.

rulings.summary: Load places credits on a card; when a loaded card is empty its 'when empty' ability triggers.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet trashes an emptied loaded card per its text.

rulings.summary: Clicks are allotted each turn; abilities may grant extra allotted clicks for the next turn or make a player spend a click.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet tracks extra allotted clicks into the next turn.

rulings.summary: The run ends phase resolves 'when the run ends' abilities; an end-run effect may be prevented by an ability.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet resolves run-end abilities after the run is over.

rulings.summary: Interrupts and replacement effects change or prevent an effect as it would happen.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet prompts prevention before the run ends.

rulings.summary: A run becomes successful in the success phase; 'if successful' effects then apply.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet resolves run-event success effects at success.

rulings.summary: Breaching a server accesses cards; abilities may access additional cards from R&D.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet adds accesses when an ability is used on breach.

rulings.summary: Credits are gained, lost, spent and hosted; hosted credits may be spent only as their host allows.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet spends hosted credits only for permitted payments.

rulings.summary: Trashing moves a card to its owner's discard pile; abilities may forbid the Runner from trashing a card.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet hides the trash option when forbidden.

rulings.summary: Modal abilities resolve the chosen number of modes; 'in any order' lets the controller order them.
rulings.jnetCrossCheck: jnet asks for modes then their order.
